name: Ena Shushi Bar
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to the Ena Shushi Bar in Tirol!**

Indulge in a unique culinary experience with our authentic Japanese sushi and shushi rolls. Whether you're craving fresh nigiri, delicious maki, or creative sashimi, our skilled chefs prepare each dish with the finest ingredients.

Pair your meal with a selection of premium Japanese beers, sake, or refreshing cocktails. The cozy atmosphere and stylish decor make this the perfect spot for a relaxed evening with friends or a romantic dinner for two.

Located in the heart of Tirol, just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, the Ena Shushi Bar offers a taste of Japan in the Alps. Come and discover why this hidden gem is a must-visit for food lovers!

**Reservations recommended.**
